description: This PHP source file defines the SavePerformanceTrackerController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Performance plugin. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the preparation of Vue components for saving or editing performance tracker data based on the HTTP request attributes.

classes.name: SavePerformanceTrackerController
classes.description: Controller responsible for initializing Vue components for saving or editing performance tracker data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request; if present, loads the edit component with the id, otherwise loads the save component.
